value: GA3 soaks shortened germination time at 15 C: germination began on day 39 in the control, day 13 at 100 mg/L and day 7 at 1000 mg/L, mean germination time fell from 82.3 d to 34.8 d at both 100 and 1000 mg/L and T50 from 85.0 d to 47.7 and 41.3 d; at 10 mg/L mean germination time (84.7 d) and T50 (95.0 d) were longer than the control; final germination at 15 C did not rise at the higher doses (83.5% control, 91.7% at 10, 79.1% at 100, 83.4% at 1000 mg/L); at 25 C final germination rose from 0.0% (control) to 6.9, 13.2 and 27.3% at 10, 100 and 1000 mg/L
method: seeds soaked in GA3 (0, 10, 100, 1000 mg/L) and incubated at 15 C and 25 C; final germination percentage, start day, mean germination time and T50 scored
conditions: incubation under a 16 h light / 8 h dark photoperiod at about 25 umol m-2 s-1; the Results report significant differences in start day among GA3 concentrations but give no significance statement for final germination, mean germination time or T50 (the Discussion says 100 and 1000 mg/L did not differ significantly); no start day is given for 25 C or for 10 mg/L at 15 C; the Discussion calls GA3 effective for germination percentage, which holds only at 25 C; without GA3, final germination at 5, 15, 20 and 25 C was 51.7, 83.5, 2.6 and 0.0%; 4, 8 and 12 weeks of 4 C stratification left germination below 10%

Mean germination time in the 10 mg/L treatment ran against the headline and is carried in the value.

value: GA3 24 h soaks of seeds prechilled 30 d at 4 C raised germination from 48.0% (0 mg/L) to 79.0% at 100 mg/L and 75.7% at 500 mg/L; higher doses gave 65.8% (1,000), 53.6% (2,000) and 39.0% (3,000 mg/L, below the control); germination rate rose from 2.71 seeds/day (control) to 3.52 at 100 mg/L, while at 2,000 and 3,000 mg/L mean germination time was longer and rate lower than the control
method: seeds prechilled at 4 C for 30 d, soaked 24 h in GA3 (0, 100, 500, 1,000, 2,000, 3,000 mg/L), 25 seeds per dish x 4 replicates, incubated at 25 C; germination (radicle 2 mm or more) counted daily for about 20 d
conditions: incubation at 25 C under light (2,000 lux); GA3 concentration had a significant effect on germination percentage (P < 0.01), mean germination time (P < 0.001) and germination rate (P < 0.001); at 100 and 500 mg/L mean germination time was similar to the control; numeric mean germination times sit only in a figure; seeds from Daecheongbong, Mt. Seorak, collected September 2011; the authors judge 100 mg/L GA3 comparable to 3 or more months of cold treatment (wet-sand stratification gave 39.0 to 86.0% over 1 to 5 months, untreated seeds about 11.0%)
